commit.message:
[Fix] `utils`: `isBuffer`: do not invoke a non-callable `constructor.isBuffer`

`isBuffer` duck-types buffers via `obj.constructor.isBuffer(obj)`
(since 3768a75 / v2.2.5, so that it works without referencing the `Buffer` global and recognizes polyfill and foreign-realm buffers),
but only checked that the property was truthy before calling it.
An object with an own `constructor` key whose `isBuffer` member is a non-function,
as produced by `qs.parse` under `plainObjects` or `allowPrototypes`,
or by `JSON.parse`,
made `stringify` throw `TypeError: obj.constructor.isBuffer is not a function`.

Require it to be callable before invoking it.
Real `Buffer`, `safer-buffer`,
and browserify `buffer` polyfill instances serialize exactly as before.
